summary: IRIS is a citizen-science + ML pipeline that maps galaxy mergers and cluster mergers using 3,587 Galaxy Zoo classifications. Blue galaxies show 6x higher merger fraction than red galaxies, and cluster validation accuracy rises from 46.7% to 94.7% with cluster richness. A Random Forest model predicts human merger labels with 89.0% accuracy, reducing human vetting by ∼10x for Rubin LSST's 20 billion galaxies.
details:
IRIS - Mapping Cosmic Collisions with Rubin LSST Cluster Buster is a citizen-science + machine learning pipeline that maps galaxy mergers and cluster mergers.

What it does: When galaxies collide, gravity creates tidal tails, bridges, and cluster mergers. IRIS classifies these faint structures at scale to prepare for Rubin LSST, which will observe 20 billion galaxies.

How it works: I contributed N=3587 classifications as independent citizen scientist @suhanakumari across 3 Zooniverse projects: 1) Galaxy Zoo: Tidal Tales - 208, ESA Euclid Q1, 2) Galaxy Zoo: Rubin DP1 Classic - 1504, Vera C. Rubin Observatory Data Preview 1, 3) Spiral Graph: Cluster Buster - 1875, DECaLS-based cluster validation. Total 12.5h certified by Zooniverse. All objects were cross-matched to DECaLS DR10 via NOIRLab TAP within 1.5" for g-r color, stellar mass, and photometric redshift.

Tools: Python in Google Colab - Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn.Key Results: 1) Blue galaxies (g-r <0.8) show 6x higher merger fraction: 13.8% vs 2.2% for red - merger-triggered star formation. 2) Cluster validation accuracy scales with richness: 46.7% (5-10 members) to 94.7% (60+ members), 87% vs professional catalog. 3) Random Forest (100 trees, 80/20 split) predicts human merger labels with 89.0% accuracy on test N=718.

Impact: Human + AI hybrid pipeline ready for Rubin LSST era. Reduces human vetting by ∼10x. Helps astronomers find rare mergers and validate clusters faster.

Full PDF, data and code backup: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1b6GYQAuFNhQp11i3IT9CPiYXLS_C9pgh/view?usp=sharing
